description: The first series to clear §8.2 in either direction. Every factor scores, and the candidate is still withheld for want of an archetype.
labelling_rationale:
The candles of s5-the-range-extreme-pool-is-external-liquidity, scored by the whole pipeline instead of the Liquidity Engine alone. They were built for 4.2(c) and turn out to be the only series in the repository that clears 8.2.

That mattered more than it sounds. Every confluence case before this one failed gates -- the quiet market fails G2 and G4, and so does every structure and ICT series re-run through the pipeline. A gate battery that could *never* pass would have looked exactly the same, and nothing in the suite would have said so. This is the affirmative half of 8.2's 'a candidate must pass all six gates'.

The UP direction clears every gate: the trend is BULLISH so G2 is satisfied trend-following, the deep pullback leaves price inside the lower half of the dealing range for G3, the FVG left behind by the decline sits at price for G4, and no opposing sweep-reclaim or failed break stands against it for G5. G1 is the 300-candle warm-up and G6 the absent wash-risk tag.

The DOWN direction fails G2 and G3 in the same window, which is the contrast that makes the pass meaningful: the same candles, the same instant, and the gates still discriminate by direction rather than waving both through.

All six factors carry a score -- F1 15, F2 5.92, F3 65, F4 50, F5 32, F6 50. 8.3 says each is 'a sum of enumerated evidence contributions', and `base_confidence` refuses a missing factor outright rather than reading absence as zero, so six numbers here is the assertion that every input was reachable. F6 is the neutral 50 because the rung above H4 is D1 and no D1 state exists in this window, which the record states in `unreachable` rather than leaving to be guessed.

Weighted, that is a base confidence of 41. It is not published, and the reason is not the floor: `archetype` is null. 8.6 says 'every publishable setup must match exactly one archetype', so a candidate matching none cannot publish whatever its confidence, and 41 would not have cleared the lowest floor of 70 anyway.

So the case pins the shape 8.6 calls the quality-over-quantity mechanism: the candidate is evaluated, scored, recorded -- and withheld. A pipeline that published this would be wrong, and so would one that discarded it, because 8.6 keeps below-floor candidates as calibration data.

The T16 row is asserted beside the candidate, because the row is written *from* the candidate and there is code in between. It carries the arithmetic the candidate object does not: a base of 36.6875 from 8.4's weighted sum, one 8.5 synergy bonus of +5 for the zone stack, neither cap bound, and 41.6875 floored to a final 41. 8.5 floors rather than rounds -- 8.7 carries 95.25 to a published 95 -- and rounding up would let a setup reach a grade band it did not make. | 2026-08-30 (s8-confluence-v26): the attribution trees now carry evidence ids and the F3/F4 entries the .score rewrap used to drop -- expected.setups[0].evidence regenerated from the same candles; scores, gates and the no-publish verdict are unchanged. | 2026-08-30 (swing walk-back fix): only the target pool's id hash moved -- pool ids embed the liquidity algo version (s5-v10); every score, gate and verdict is unchanged, which is itself evidence the fix did not alter this dataset's swings. This case additionally carries the clauses its stored row was already pinning without naming them. The row is the four stages of 8.1 in order and nothing else: gate_results, then the six factor scores, then the adjustments, then the archetype test. Its `attribution` names every contribution that produced a factor -- F1 clean_record 15, F2 target_pool 5.9166..., F3 grade 25 plus state 25 plus stack 15, F4 the volume factor's own 50, F5 acceleration 12 plus no_exhaustion 20 with the aligned component absent because momentum is NEUTRAL, F6 htf_ranging 50 -- which is 8.3's requirement that a factor be a sum of enumerated contributions rather than a number. Those six weight to the base of 36.6875 that 8.4 specifies, the zone-stack bonus of +5 is applied and itemised, and the total is floored to 41 rather than rounded. `archetype_unmet` lists what each of A1 to A5 still wants, which is 8.6's requirement chains stated per archetype. Each of these was confirmed by mutating the engine and watching this expectation fail; the components that no mutation could reach from here are recorded as pending in the manifest instead. | 2026-09-13 (harness wires T17): the confluence runner now hands the engine a signal repository, so the publish path runs instead of returning before 15.3 is evaluated. expected.signals is empty -- the no-publish verdict is now asserted on the signals table itself, not only on the candidate's publishable flag. Nothing else in this expectation moved. | 2026-09-13 (sweep class taken at the sweep candle, liquidity s5-v11): only pool-id hashes moved -- pool ids embed the liquidity algo version, and the fixed engine with its version literal held at s5-v10 reproduces the previous expected block byte for byte, so no score, gate or verdict changed. | 2026-09-14 (each sweep fact published once, liquidity s5-v12): only pool-id hashes moved -- pool ids embed the liquidity algo version, and the fixed engine with its version literal held at s5-v11 reproduces the previous expected block byte for byte, so no score, gate or verdict changed. | 2026-09-14 (pool map decided by candle order, liquidity s5-v13): pool-id hashes moved with the version, and the target pool is born on its pivot's first confirmation, three candles sooner, so F2 rose 5.917 -> 6.010 (base confidence 36.688 -> 36.702). Final confidence 41, the failed floor and the no-publish verdict are unchanged -- with the liquidity version held at s5-v12 in every module those are the only lines that move. | 2026-09-15 (each candle decided once, audit M3: liquidity s5-v14, ict s6-v6, ote s6-ote-v6, ob s6-ob-v8, participation v3): only 64-hex ids moved -- pool, zone and evidence ids embed their engine's algo version. With every 64-hex id masked, each removed line equals its added line; no score, gate, archetype or verdict changed. A single pass has no record of decided candles, so M3 changes nothing else here. (Holding the version literals is not a valid check for this change: confluence's CURRENT_ZONE_VERSIONS is built at import time, so held ICT versions filter every zone out.) | 2026-09-16 (sweep maturation decides each candle once, liquidity s5-v15): only pool-id hashes moved -- pool ids embed the liquidity algo version, and the fixed engine with its version literal held at s5-v14 reproduces the previous expected block byte for byte, so no score, gate or verdict changed. | 2026-09-19 (pool lifecycle decides each candle once, liquidity s5-v16): only pool-id hashes moved -- pool ids embed the liquidity algo version, and the fixed engine with its version literal held at s5-v15 reproduces the previous expected block byte for byte, so no score, gate or verdict changed.
